notes.title: FutureKreate runs on Linux!
notes.content:
FutureKreate can run in Linux OS!
Use Steam Play(Proton) to play FutureKreate on Linux!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/a7c995e50dd06eeed46cafb5e21cc7c0fad05d17.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/36b8ff964f63663fd35a1890b0373b3f626d14a3.png[/img]

[h1]Installation for FutureKreate in Linux[/h1]
FutureKreate Dev Team enviroment is Lenovo Legion 7i, Geforce RTX 2070 with Max-Q design, intel core i7, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS. We used the nvidia 470 graphics driver.


[h2]Steam Installation[/h2]
1. Install the 32 bit packages. Steam Client can only work in 32 bit mode.
$sudo dpkg --add-architecture i386
$sudo add-apt-repository multiverse
$sudo apt update
$sudo apt install libnvidia-gl-470:i386

2. Install steam-devices and steam.
$ sudo apt install steam steam-devices
$ sudo apt remove steam

3. Reinstall steam from website.
Access https://store.steampowered.com/about/ from your browser(firefox), and download the latest steam client.
$ sudo apt install ~/Downloads/steam*.deb

4. SteamOS-Ubuntu Install
We are going to install SteamOS on Ubuntu.
$cd ~/
$git clone https://github.com/ShadowApex/steamos-ubuntu

after that, replace this line: 
INCLUDE_GPU_DRIVERS="${INCLUDE_GPU_DRIVERS:-true}"
to : 
INCLUDE_GPU_DRIVERS="false"

Also, replace this:
wget "http://repo.steamstatic.com/steamos/pool/main/s/steamos-compositor/steamos-compositor_${STEAMOS_COMPOSITOR_VER}.deb"
wget "http://repo.steamstatic.com/steamos/pool/main/s/steamos-modeswitch-inhibitor/steamos-modeswitch-inhibitor_${STEAMOS_MODESWITCH_VER}.deb"
wget "http://repo.steamstatic.com/steamos/pool/main/p/plymouth-themes-steamos/plymouth-themes-steamos_${STEAMOS_PLYMOUTH_VER}.deb"
to : 
wget "http://repo.steampowered.com/steamos/pool/main/s/steamos-compositor/steamos-compositor_${STEAMOS_COMPOSITOR_VER}.deb"
wget "http://repo.steampowered.com/steamos/pool/main/s/steamos-modeswitch-inhibitor/steamos-modeswitch-inhibitor_${STEAMOS_MODESWITCH_VER}.deb"
wget "http://repo.steampowered.com/steamos/pool/main/p/plymouth-themes-steamos/plymouth-themes-steamos_${STEAMOS_PLYMOUTH_VER}.deb

[b]This is a must option.[/b]
$ gedit ~/steamos-ubuntu/install.sh 

After replacing the config, execute this command.
$ sudo ./install.sh

[h2]Steam Setting[/h2]
1. Enable Steam Play
Enable Steam Play following the link introduction.
Choose the Proton Version to Experimental.
https://itsfoss.com/steam-play/

2. If you are enabling SteamOS boot, then enable "Interface -> Enable Access to the desktop" option

3. Install FutureKreate! It takes a while for the first install.

notes.title: Remote Play Together Customer Support and Bugfix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/60194fc02fe770f3b7c6c082ee634079d3a65865.png[/img]
We supported FutureKreate user "how to use CREATOR MODE" using Remote Play Together.
1. Upload the Holand Loptaro robot 3D blueprint (the character in story mode) 
2. Color Loptaro
3. Make it move

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/fc4245de21f29bd1fb8af56b40b693c8972c7fc1.png[/img]
We succeeded in supporting the user uploading the robot, changing the size, and changing to the favorite color.
However, the final robot transfer failed.

Today, we tested the CREATOR MODE with various computers with the cooperation of a University Professor in Robotics.
We figured out CREATOR MODE works with no problem if you are using a PC bought before 2021, however, if you are using a PC bought in 2021, then the CREATOR MODE doesn't work properly.
We fixed this problem in under 24 hours.
Now, it is able to use CREATOR MODE with a PC bought in 2021. 

Currently, we are supporting Early Access users via Remote Play Together and Discord VC!
FutureKreate Dev Team is very happy to fix bugs!
We are going to make FutureKreate a great game!
Feel free to ask questions and requests!

notes.title: Update: You can teleport your house into FutureKreate!
notes.content:
In yesterday update, we added a feature to upload your room floor plans in CREATOR MODE!
You can upload floor plans as many as you can!
You can even make an aerial city using a real 3D floor plan in Creator Mode!
You can see the Creator Mode buildings in the screenshots user posts!

[h2]How to Use[/h2]
[olist]
[h3][*]Enter Creator Mode, then press H key.[/h3]
[h3][*]Upload your 3D floor plans.[/h3] 
There are many open 3d floor plan site on the Internet!
Also [b]you have to convert the floor plan to .obj format.[/b]
To convert to OBJ,  this site is pretty useful.
[url=https://www.meshconvert.com/]https://www.meshconvert.com/[/url]
[b]Please rename the file which doesn't include two dots[/b] before uploading the file to FutureKreate.
(model.dae.obj : NG, model.obj : GOOD)
[h3][*] Set the room world position using the x, y, z[m] field.[/h3]
If you want to set up the direction, set up the yaw, pitch, roll field.
[h3][*]Proceed next by pressing > button, and select materials.[/h3]
You can choose concretes, various woods, bricks, tiles, etc!
[h3][*]Proceed next by pressing > button, and wait for house transfer.[/h3]
You can walk the garden and room after this setup.
[/olist]

notes.title: v1.1β : Build your own civilization!
notes.content:
We've added a beta version of the building feature to our story mode!
As the first step to reincarnating into a robot and creating a civilization in an A.I. generated FutureKreate Island, Build your own house and facilities!
The rubble of buildings destroyed by war was turned into recycled concrete building materials by the AI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/6d3d848329ffd15465ae06e8176277f880d6cd9c.png[/img]

You became a robot! Build houses on the ocean floor, or even in the air at an altitude of over 1000 meters!
You can clear and level the land with the Foundation parts. This feature makes it possible to create reclaimed lands and bridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/9400a7c33c807b71a701b5e4b039af3daf5efcbd.png[/img].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/0219a6b1b1c150bd9711c7d5ab2eb8dada381dbb.png[/img]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
After opening the building menu with the B button, 4 building objects can be used with 1-4 keyboard button.
Recycled rubble concrete foundation: Keyboard 1
Recycled rubble concrete walls: Keyboard 2
Recycled rubble concrete ceiling: Keyboard 3
Lantern: Keyboard 4
Left-click to place a building, right-click to delete it.
You can place buildings by left-clicking and delete them by right-clicking.
※Building Feature currently does not support controller(PS4 DUALSHOCK)

[h2]Future Plans[/h2]
In the future, we'll be adding much more natural environments, looting and mining, robotics competition mode, quests, Steam achievements for building, and more!
Also in CREATOR MODE, we are going to add a 3D floorplan upload feature for buildings.

[h2]Confirmed bugs[/h2]
If you move the camera more than a certain distance away, the LOD will cause the building hitbox to disappear.
Please note that the saved data will be lost when the game is updated, although the buildings created by the building function are temporarily saved.

notes.title: Robot Contest Post 1 : Holland Loptaro
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=toQcJXNYgzI;full][/previewyoutube]

There are many interesting posts in the FutureKreate character contest held in Japan. We are going to add a new robot character based on this post. 

[h2]Robot Introduction[/h2]
[b]Character Name : Holland Loptaro[/b]
[b]Creator : Keita[/b]
[b]Introduction : I made this character in the motif of Holland Lop. He is very cute.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39337230/9e28326788493a07d4bab97e4b0eade7774d4305.jpg[/img]

FutureKreate Dev Team made this design as a 3DCAD design from the rough sketch.
The creator is 13 years old.
He wanted to create a robot after simulating in FutureKreate, so I made this robot as a tracked vehicle for making the robot cost low and manufacturing easy.  
Tracked vehicle enables to run outside environment very smoothly.
